import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import re
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")


# Text preprocessing function
def preprocess_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text).lower()
    text = re.sub(r"http\S+|www\S+", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s\.\!\?]", " ", text)
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    return text


# Apply preprocessing
train_df["comment_text"] = train_df["comment_text"].apply(preprocess_text)
test_df["comment_text"] = test_df["comment_text"].apply(preprocess_text)

target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Validation split (stratified on toxic to preserve structure)
X_train_full = train_df["comment_text"]
y_train_full = train_df[target_cols]

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full,
    y_train_full,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_full["toxic"],
)

# TF-IDF vectorizer
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=25000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    stop_words="english",
)

X_train_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_val)

# Train calibrated classifiers on validation data
classifiers = []
val_preds = np.zeros((X_val.shape[0], len(target_cols)))

for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    pos_count = y_train[col].sum()
    neg_count = len(y_train) - pos_count
    weight_pos = len(y_train) / (2 * pos_count) if pos_count > 0 else 1.0
    weight_neg = len(y_train) / (2 * neg_count) if neg_count > 0 else 1.0

    base_clf = LogisticRegression(
        C=1.0,
        class_weight={0: weight_neg, 1: weight_pos},
        max_iter=1000,
        solver="lbfgs",
        n_jobs=-1,
        random_state=42,
    )
    base_clf.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train[col])

    cal_clf = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_clf, method="isotonic", cv="prefit")
    cal_clf.fit(X_val_tfidf, y_val[col])
    classifiers.append(cal_clf)
    val_preds[:, i] = cal_clf.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)[:, 1]

# Compute validation AUC
val_scores = []
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    score = roc_auc_score(y_val[col], val_preds[:, i])
    val_scores.append(score)
    print(f"{col} AUC: {score:.4f}")

mean_auc = np.mean(val_scores)
print(f"\nMean column-wise ROC AUC (calibrated): {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Final model training with internal CV calibration on full data
tfidf_full = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=25000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    stop_words="english",
)
X_train_full_tfidf = tfidf_full.fit_transform(X_train_full)
X_test_tfidf = tfidf_full.transform(test_df["comment_text"])

final_classifiers = []
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    pos_count = y_train_full[col].sum()
    neg_count = len(y_train_full) - pos_count
    weight_pos = len(y_train_full) / (2 * pos_count) if pos_count > 0 else 1.0
    weight_neg = len(y_train_full) / (2 * neg_count) if neg_count > 0 else 1.0

    base_clf = LogisticRegression(
        C=1.0,
        class_weight={0: weight_neg, 1: weight_pos},
        max_iter=1000,
        solver="lbfgs",
        n_jobs=-1,
        random_state=42,
    )
    base_clf.fit(X_train_full_tfidf, y_train_full[col])

    # Apply internal CV calibration to ensure calibrated test predictions
    cal_clf_final = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_clf, method="isotonic", cv=3)
    cal_clf_final.fit(X_train_full_tfidf, y_train_full[col])
    final_classifiers.append(cal_clf_final)

# Generate test predictions
test_preds = np.zeros((test_df.shape[0], len(target_cols)))
for i, clf in enumerate(final_classifiers):
    test_preds[:, i] = clf.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)[:, 1]

# Clip and save submission
submission_df = sample_sub.copy()
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    submission_df[col] = np.clip(test_preds[:, i], 0, 1)

submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
